subject: applied-mathematics
name: Applied Mathematics
note: Draft taxonomy for the CURRENT LC Applied Mathematics specification (NCCA 2021 spec, first examined 2023). Every node carries a specRef quoting the 'STUDENTS LEARN ABOUT' cell it derives from (spec text: /tmp/applied_maths_spec.txt, pages 16-21). The old pre-2023 syllabus (SHM, statics, hydrostatics, moments of inertia, relative velocity as standalone) is deliberately ABSENT. CONVENTION: ids are 0-indexed (applied-mathematics-1 = 'Strand 2'); names carry the spec's 1-indexed strand numbers. TAGGING RULE (verified): 'apply Dijkstra/Kruskal/Prim' cards -> 1-2/1-3; 'classify/justify greedy-vs-DP' cards -> 1-4. Momentum-conservation cards home in 2-4 (p19 outcomes), never 2-6 (p20's energy-only outcomes). LIMITATION: HL-only (bold) outcome status is NOT encoded — the text extraction loses bold; source any level-tagging from the spec PDF itself. VERIFIED 2026-06-10 by a 5-lens adversarial panel (spec-fidelity x2, HL+OL exam coverage 2023-2025 exhaustive, old-spec contamination) + completeness critic: 5/5 pass, 0 blockers — see applied-maths-taxonomy-verify.workflow.js.

subtopics.name: The Problem-Solving Cycle
subtopics.specRef: p16 cell 'The problem-solving cycle' — describe a systematic process for solving problems and making decisions

subtopics.name: Formulating Problems
subtopics.specRef: p16 cell 'Formulating problems' — research background, relevant variables, decompose, simplifying assumptions

subtopics.name: Translating Problems into Mathematics
subtopics.specRef: p16 cell 'Translating problems into mathematics' — abstraction, build a solvable model from problem + assumptions

subtopics.name: Computing Solutions
subtopics.specRef: p16 cell 'Computing solutions' — solve with appropriate mathematics + computational technology, interpret in context

subtopics.name: Evaluating Solutions
subtopics.specRef: p16 cell 'Evaluating solutions' — refine/iterate the model, communicate in a written report

strands.name: Strand 2: Mathematical Modelling with Networks and Graphs
strands.specRef: p17 'Strand 2: Mathematical modelling with networks and graphs'

subtopics.name: Networks and Their Associated Terminology
subtopics.specRef: p17 cell 'Networks and their associated terminology' — vertex/node, edge/arc, weight, path, cycle; connected/disconnected; directed/undirected

subtopics.name: Matrices, Matrix Algebra and Adjacency
subtopics.specRef: p17 same cell 'Matrices, matrix algebra and adjacency' — adjacency matrix <-> graph, multiply square matrices, interpret the product

subtopics.name: Minimum Spanning Trees (Kruskal and Prim)
subtopics.specRef: p17 cell 'Minimum spanning trees applied to problems involving optimising networks and algorithms associated with finding these (Kruskal, Prim)'

subtopics.name: Dynamic Programming and Shortest Paths (Bellman, Dijkstra)
subtopics.specRef: p17 cell 'Dynamic Programming and shortest paths as applied to multi-stage authentic problems such as stock control, routing problems, allocation of resources, equipment replacement and maintenance' — stage/state/optimal policy, Bellman's Principle of Optimality, Dijkstra's algorithm

subtopics.name: Algorithms: Greedy vs Dynamic Programming
subtopics.specRef: p17 cell 'Algorithms: Dijkstra; Bellman; Kruskal, Prim' — distinguish greedy vs dynamic-programming algorithms, justify correctness/optimality

subtopics.name: Project Scheduling and Critical Paths
subtopics.specRef: p17 cell 'Analysis of project scheduling networks / Project scheduling and its associated terminology' — critical path, early times, late times, floats

strands.name: Strand 3: Mathematically Modelling the Physical World; Kinematics and Dynamics
strands.specRef: p18 'Strand 3: Mathematically modelling the physical world; kinematics and dynamics'

subtopics.name: Kinematics: Particle Motion in One Dimension
subtopics.specRef: p18 cell 'Kinematics: Particle motion in one direction' — idealisations; position/displacement/velocity/acceleration/time; s-t and v-t graphs; v=u+at, s=ut+half at^2, v^2=u^2+2as

subtopics.name: Describing Motion with Calculus
subtopics.specRef: p18 second 1D cell — velocity/acceleration as derivatives; chain rule; fundamental theorem of calculus; definite integral as area (Riemann); derive the kinematic formulae using calculus

subtopics.name: Particle Motion in 2D: Vectors and Projectile Motion
subtopics.specRef: p19 cell 'Particle motion in 2D' — vector algebra (addition, scalar multiplication, dot product), vector calculus, components/unit vectors/polar form, projectile motion (time of flight, max height, max range, horizontal planes), Newton's laws in vector form

subtopics.name: Forces, Newton's Laws and Free-Body Diagrams
subtopics.specRef: p19 cell 'Forces acting on a particle' (forces part) — mass; applied/normal reaction/frictional/resistant/tension/gravitational/resultant forces; Newton's laws; free-body diagrams; resultant on horizontal/inclined planes

subtopics.name: Momentum, Impulse and Collisions
subtopics.specRef: p19 same cell (momentum part) — momentum, impulse, conservation of momentum (1D + 2D two-particle), Newton's experimental law, elastic/inelastic collisions, coefficient of restitution, direct + oblique collisions

subtopics.name: Connected Masses, Friction and Drag
subtopics.specRef: p19 same cell (applications part) — connected masses; rough/smooth surfaces; coefficient of friction; drag F prop v^n; integration by parts/substitution for resistive-force problems

subtopics.name: Work, Energy and Conservation
subtopics.specRef: p20 cell 'Work, energy, conservative forces, conservation of energy and momentum' — work-energy model, conservation of energy, work by gravity/variable conservative force/elastic spring or string, GPE + KE

subtopics.name: Circular Motion of a Particle
subtopics.specRef: p20 cell 'Circular Motion of a particle' — dynamics of a particle in a horizontal or vertical circle

subtopics.name: Dimensional Analysis
subtopics.specRef: p20 cell 'Dimensional analysis' — evaluate whether an answer is reasonable by analysing dimensions

strands.name: Strand 4: Mathematically Modelling a Changing World
strands.specRef: p21 'Strand 4: Mathematically modelling a changing world'

subtopics.name: Recurrence Relations and Differences
subtopics.specRef: p21 cell 'Recurrence relations' — compute first and higher differences of a sequence

subtopics.name: Modelling Incremental Change with Difference Equations
subtopics.specRef: p21 cell 'Real-world phenomena involving incremental change' — Malthusian/restricted growth, interest/loan payment, supply and demand, spread of diseases; identify/derive/analyse/solve difference equations in context

subtopics.name: Solving Difference Equations (Homogeneous and Inhomogeneous)
subtopics.specRef: p21 cell 'Solving homogeneous and inhomogeneous difference equations numerically, graphically and with the aid of digital technology' — solve linear and non-linear difference equations

subtopics.name: Modelling Continuous Change with Differential Equations
subtopics.specRef: p21 cell 'Analysing real-world phenomena involving continuous change / Predictive nature of differential equations' — identify/derive/interpret differential equations in context (decay, cooling, growth, disease, continuous interest)

subtopics.name: Solving Differential Equations (Separable; Reducible Second-Order)
subtopics.specRef: p21 cell 'Techniques for solving differential equations' — separation of variables, numerical solutions, graphical/qualitative methods; first-order separable + second-order reducible to first-order; interpret solutions in context
